justification: Documentation of a code-quality review plus one read-only script (scripts/qa_live_files.py) that reads files and prints a list. No served code, no database, no workflow changes. Nothing the app serves changes.

break_it.scenario: The live-file list calls a used file 'unreached', so the review never scores it.
break_it.what_happens: A bad file escapes the scorecard. Checked by hand on 6 random unreached frontend files: each was imported only by other unreached files.
break_it.how: Entry points are read from Dockerfiles, railway tomls, run_monitors.MONITORS and workflows, not typed. Limits (computed-name imports, npm packages) are printed in the output header. Re-run on an exact copy of a6d2e378 gave an identical list.

break_it.scenario: A tool skips files and the baseline undercounts.
break_it.what_happens: This happened: ruff and jscpd skipped gitignored-but-tracked enrichment/extractors/. Caught by recounting ruff live hits a second way (2,471 vs 2,669). Re-run without the skip; both recounts now agree.
break_it.how: Recorded in docs/qa/quality-baseline-2026-10-25/README.md; failed attempts kept in raw/_runs.tsv.

post_merge.secrets: None. No secret or env var added or read.
post_merge.other_repo: None. No other repo or deploy touched.
post_merge.manual_verify: None needed: docs and a read-only script; nothing served changes.
